Require |cP-cI|<=EP+EI at identical x*,K,v; shared endpoint error cannot hide method disagreement. The two finest-amplitude C1,C2 must also be negative beyond their propagated grid/periodic/roundoff error. Failure rejects this witness only; the existential hypothesis remains unresolved. For the C1,C2 guard, recompute the four axis and six mixed estimates on Cj itself (same tables), add its periodic/roundoff/tail bounds and Eep+Eepsilon, and require each resulting upper estimate <0.
error_certificate.early_exit: No endpoint, ambiguous topology, no eligible primary witness, failed error assumptions/controls, incomplete diagnostic, >128 iterations, resource exhaustion or method disagreement => inconclusive/technical disposition. error_certificate.endpoint_box: For each coordinate x=(T,Delta,q,h), use Eseq for angular and frequency root sequences with the other resolution finest, and for the three finest-grid solver tolerances. At each root b_i=max(1e-12 max(1,|x_i|),(|Jg^-1| |g|)_i). Add 4 times the absolute fine-minus-medium mixed angular/frequency root contrast. Add (2|Jg^-1| |g_C5(x*)-g_C3(x*)|)_i for the tail diagnostic. The sum defines rho_i. Require the corresponding coarse-to-fine mixed contrast to contract by 0.75 within propagated roundoff, a nonsingular Jg with cond_inf<=1e10, rho_i<=0.01 max(1,|x_i*|), and ||I-Jg(x*)^-1 Jg(x)||_inf<=0.5 at all box corners. All box points must remain in the source bracket with Delta,T>0 and positive amplitude curvature. These sampled checks define an empirical endpoint uncertainty box, not a proved enclosure; failure is inconclusive.
error_certificate.endpoint_propagation: Let c(x)=Re[vdagger M(x,K)v]/N0 using fixed v,K. At each coordinate compute centered slopes at rho_i and rho_i/2; require their difference <=0.25 times their maximum magnitude plus propagated rounding/rho_i. Let s_i be the largest absolute one-sided slope on those four axial probes; let g_i be the centered half-radius slope. Eep=2 sum_i rho_i s_i + 2 max_corners |c(x)-c(x*)-sum_i g_i(x_i-x_i*)|, with primary quadrature/roundoff error of all probes added using absolute coefficients. Use the same Eep as a disclosed common endpoint systematic in both sign assessments. Failure of local smoothness or branch identity is inconclusive.

primary_protocol.endpoint: Recover the same source-connected endpoint with real analytic/automatic derivatives of the supplied functional and implicit amplitude branch; no complex-step differentiation through Re. Root system g=(R,J,dJ/dq,d2J/dq2). Use all nine (Ntheta,Nomega) pairs from {64,128,256} x {128,256,512}, with C3+C5 tails. At the finest pair retain root solves at residual targets 1e-8,1e-10,1e-12. Total at most 900 uniform/derivative evaluations, including topology checks; 600 CPU seconds jointly for uniform and primary work. Failure to recover the source branch within these bounds is inconclusive.
primary_protocol.finiteK_search: At most 40 candidates: nonzero K_lambda=2 lambda h-q along x, rotated by 0,pi/4,pi/2,3pi/4 and scaled by 0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5. Screen each on (64,128),(128,256),(256,512). Only 0.25<=|K|<=20 is implementable by the prepared periodic code; record exclusions without changing the all-K claim. No local search expansion. Total cap 207 finite-K matrix evaluations, reserving the balance after at most 120 screening evaluations for the selected witness and controls.
primary_protocol.selected_matrix_checks: At fixed x*,K compute all nine primary angular/frequency matrices; use operator norms for matrix error estimates. Evaluate endpoint sensitivities at x* +/-rho_i e_i and x* +/-rho_i e_i/2, and all 16 box corners, always at fixed K,v. This uses at most 120+9+32=161 matrices, leaving at least 46 of the 207 cap for controls/reused computations. No K->0 sequence can be a witness. For each full primary evaluation, reduce its nested angular/frequency integrands to all nine quadratures, with recomputed tails, so every endpoint probe has its own EP estimate without nine separate trajectory integrations.
primary_protocol.selection: Select the lowest fine-grid Rayleigh quotient among candidates passing the primary error rules, then freeze x*,K,v with ||v||=1 before any nonlinear perturbation. Tie within numerical error: lexicographic (Kx,Ky). The primary assessment uses the same frozen v, never a separately optimized eigenvector per grid. If the selected witness fails confirmation, retain failure and stop; no replacement witness in this allocation.
